brief:
An-Najah National University and civil society organizations in Nablus organized a solidarity gathering to express support for Jordan, the Ma'an news agency reported. The event brought together students and activists to demonstrate Palestinian backing for the neighboring kingdom.

Details of the rally's specific aims and timing were not immediately available. The gathering reflected broader efforts by Palestinian civil society to maintain ties with Arab neighbors.
title: An-Najah University and Nablus activists hold solidarity rally for Jordan
